title: Staff Full Stack Engineer, Payments Dashboard
searchText: Staff Full Stack Engineer, Payments Dashboard Stripe Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Payments Dashboard group is a newly formed organization focused on Stripe’s dashboard. This team serves as the platform, center of excellence, and owner of some of the highest visited pages on stripe.com ’s merchant dashboard. These surfaces are used for core user flows with Stripe - including integration setup and settings, transactions list and data exports, receipts, and foundational operational pages. The forward-looking charter of this team is to establish new information architecture and a centralized place to configure, manage and optimize these user integrations. What you’ll do We’re looking for a staff full-stack engineer to join this group. This engineer will be working alongside multiple engineering teams within the Payments Dashboard group, and with multiple organizations outside of it. They will work to enable the teams around them, focusing variously on core dashboard availability and latency, new information architecture and customer flows, and helping engineering teams work efficiently and optimize their operational load. Responsibilities Design and reason about integration experiences with a strong focus on end-user simplicity and developer experience Build full-stack solutions across Stripe's ecosystem, including back-end services, dashboard interfaces, and integrations with other Stripe primitives Engage directly with users to understand their business needs and translate requirements into concrete solutions Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, and other engineering teams to deliver these solutions Write code in your day-to-day job, in addition to helping make those around you better view code review and design feedback Help scale our systems to handle millions of transactions while maintaining high availability and performance Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 12+ years of experience as a full-stack engineer Ability to take ambiguous product requirements and problems and turn them into working software solutions Experience leading teams that have shipped and maintained critical user-facing products Strong technical proficiency to engage thoughtfully with engineers about architecture and product design, with a particular focus on modern web technologies, performance, and user experience Experience building extensible, leveraged software solutions that scale to different kinds of user needs, with the ability to empathize with users and advocate for exceptional user experiences Preferred qualifications History of working on geographically distributed teams Previous experiences working in payments and on payments technology Previous experience using Stripe products Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use... Seattle 8513 Payments Experience - Eng US full-stack-engineer backend-engineer Greenhouse
